reference.title: Add 5-layer progressive disclosure for video discussions
reference.summary: Reviewed a SageOx server-side summarization proposal for a 5-layer progressive-disclosure model on video discussions (with keyframes and visual support), compared it against the ox CLI's current 3-layer state, and implemented the missing layers. Created a beads epic (ox-c7r) with 7 tasks, built pkg/discussion with types (DiscussionSummary, Chapter, Keyframe, Annotation) and loaders, and added 26 table-driven loader tests. Code review surfaced four issues: duplicate annotation routing, AgentSummary deduplication, vocabulary drift from the proposal, and missing coverage — all fixed. A rebase onto main required resolving JSONL-format conflicts from an unrelated merge. Shipped as PR #293 with 3 commits and documentation distinguishing summary.json from annotations.json.
key_actions: Gap analysis of current 3-layer vs proposed 5-layer progressive disclosure
Created beads epic ox-c7r with 7 implementation tasks
Built pkg/discussion with types.go and loader.go
Extracted categorizeAnnotations() helper for annotation type routing
Fixed AgentSummary duplication and vocabulary drift from review
Resolved rebase conflicts with main's JSONL format change
Documented summary.json vs annotations.json and opened PR #293
